body:
{"announcements":[{"date":"2026-10-15","content":"
  • Added additional fields to the related properties section
  • Added trademark staff and location data
  • Added an option to sort by filing date
  • Fixed several data display bugs
","visible":true},{"date":"2026-08-13","notes":["Added the related properties section to the search results page","Added a reference number option to the drop-down menu","Fixed several data display bugs"],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Added the related properties section to the search results page
  • Added a reference number option to the drop-down menu
  • Fixed several data display bugs
"},{"date":"2026-06-11","notes":["Users can search results using international registration number","Fixed several data display bugs"],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Users can search results using international registration number
  • Fixed several data display bugs
"},{"date":"2026-04-30","notes":["Users can now customize/include additional sections to their summary page when signed in.","Fixed several data display bugs."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Users can now customize/include additional sections to their summary page when signed in.
  • Fixed several data display bugs.
"},{"date":"2026-04-09","notes":["Added a new feature to the drop-down menu that allows users who are logged into their USPTO.gov account to search our database by image. ","We’re aware of these bugs and will fix them in our next release on April 30, 2026:","Search results will only include the top 1,000 results instead of all possible results.","Users will see an error when filtering by class A, B or 200."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Added a new feature to the drop-down menu that allows users who are logged into their USPTO.gov account to search our database by image.
  • We’re aware of these bugs and will fix them in our next release on April 30, 2026:
  • Search results will only include the top 1,000 results instead of all possible results.
  • Users will see an error when filtering by class A, B or 200.
"},{"date":"2026-03-10","notes":["Expand/collapse option to the goods and services section in search results","Transliteration field to the trademark details page","Maintenance data and date fields on the trademark details page","Link to TSDR on the search summary","Search by proceeding number","Taking users to the details page instead of the summary page when searching by a single registration or serial number","Automatic opt-in to new beta feature that shows detailed information about trademarks","Bug fix: Custom view preferences are now saved and displayed"],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Expand/collapse option to the goods and services section in search results
  • Transliteration field to the trademark details page
  • Maintenance data and date fields on the trademark details page
  • Link to TSDR on the search summary
  • Search by proceeding number
  • Taking users to the details page instead of the summary page when searching by a single registration or serial number
  • Automatic opt-in to new beta feature that shows detailed information about trademarks
  • Bug fix: Custom view preferences are now saved and displayed
"},{"date":"2026-01-22","notes":["Fixed a bug that caused search results to show a country name instead of a state name.","Moved the goods and services section above the owner section.","Made “Wordmark” the default drop-down option instead of “General search.”","Removed the basic mode for searching, allowing all users to see the functionality found in expert mode.","Enhanced a feature that converts curly and single quotes to straight quotes.","Added the date of first use and date of first use in commerce to the search results page.","Added the attorney’s law firm or company name to the search results page.","Added the attorney’s docket number to the search results page.","Added the foreign priority claim to the search results page."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Fixed a bug that caused search results to show a country name instead of a state name.
  • Moved the goods and services section above the owner section.
  • Made “Wordmark” the default drop-down option instead of “General search.”
  • Removed the basic mode for searching, allowing all users to see the functionality found in expert mode.
  • Enhanced a feature that converts curly and single quotes to straight quotes.
  • Added the date of first use and date of first use in commerce to the search results page.
  • Added the attorney’s law firm or company name to the search results page.
  • Added the attorney’s docket number to the search results page.
  • Added the foreign priority claim to the search results page.
"},{"date":"2026-01-07","notes":[""],"visible":false,"content":"
"},{"date":"2025-12-11","notes":["Fixed a bug that prevented users from seeing results when filtering by class in expert mode.","Fixed a bug that didn’t properly show customized selections.","Removed an unnecessary checkbox."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Fixed a bug that prevented users from seeing results when filtering by class in expert mode.
  • Fixed a bug that didn’t properly show customized selections.
  • Removed an unnecessary checkbox.
"},{"date":"2025-11-13","notes":["Fixed a bug to make search responses match TSDR language.","Added icons on the results page to indicate trademark registration status."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Fixed a bug to make search responses match TSDR language.
  • Added icons on the results page to indicate trademark registration status.
"},{"date":"2025-09-12","notes":["Detailed trademark status data can now be viewed within the search system. ","Resolved an issue with where the exported file may have omitted a small number of results when users chose the “First 500 results” export option."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Detailed trademark status data can now be viewed within the search system.
  • Resolved an issue with where the exported file may have omitted a small number of results when users chose the “First 500 results” export option.
"},{"date":"2025-04-24","notes":["Launched an alert feature to notify users about the status of the search system.","Fixed an issue that displayed inconsistent results between the search system and TSDR for sensory mark images."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Launched an alert feature to notify users about the status of the search system.
  • Fixed an issue that displayed inconsistent results between the search system and TSDR for sensory mark images.
"},{"date":"2025-03-13","notes":["Fixed a bug where wordmark character '^' became ' ^ '","Fixed a bug that showed some canceled registrations as live.","Fixed a bug so users can click on a wordmark link in both expert mode and list view.","Fixed several Section 508 accessibility errors on the help page and the search result page in expert mode.","Fixed bug where the class filter in expert mode didn’t show any results.","Updated error codes to show different codes for logged in and guest users."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Fixed a bug where wordmark character '^' became ' ^ '
  • Fixed a bug that showed some canceled registrations as live.
  • Fixed a bug so users can click on a wordmark link in both expert mode and list view.
  • Fixed several Section 508 accessibility errors on the help page and the search result page in expert mode.
  • Fixed bug where the class filter in expert mode didn’t show any results.
  • Updated error codes to show different codes for logged in and guest users.
"},{"date":"2024-12-05","notes":["Fixed a bug where switching between Basic and Expert modes led to filtering errors and inactive class filters.","Fixed several Section 508 accessibility errors to improve accessibility of TM Search."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Fixed a bug where switching between Basic and Expert modes led to filtering errors and inactive class filters.
  • Fixed several Section 508 accessibility errors to improve accessibility of TM Search.
"},{"date":"2024-10-17","notes":["Added a customization feature for logged in users to save preferred search modes and settings.","Added the USPTO virtual assistant to answer common trademark questions.","Fixed a bug where some filters weren't being reset when switching between Basic and Expert modes.","Fixed a bug where switching between Basic and Expert modes while searching by field tag introduced errors."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Added a customization feature for logged in users to save preferred search modes and settings.
  • Added the USPTO virtual assistant to answer common trademark questions.
  • Fixed a bug where some filters weren't being reset when switching between Basic and Expert modes.
  • Fixed a bug where switching between Basic and Expert modes while searching by field tag introduced errors.
"},{"date":"2024-07-29","notes":["Fixed bug where clicking the View details button on a Summary page didn't open TSDR.","Fixed bug where the search refinement sometimes reset to General search for logged in users."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Fixed bug where clicking the View details button on a Summary page didn't open TSDR.
  • Fixed bug where the search refinement sometimes reset to General search for logged in users.
"},{"date":"2024-07-11","notes":["Added a feature that displays the mark image for the 'Results on page' export option for those logged into their USPTO.gov account."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Added a feature that displays the mark image for the 'Results on page' export option for those logged into their USPTO.gov account.
"},{"date":"2024-07-9","notes":["Fixed a bug where the dates on the Summary page displayed incorrectly.","Fixed a bug where the checkbox to tag marks was superimposed on the mark details when images aren't shown."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Fixed a bug where the dates on the Summary page displayed incorrectly.
  • Fixed a bug where the checkbox to tag marks was superimposed on the mark details when images aren't shown.
"},{"date":"2024-06-28","notes":["Clarified error messages for search syntax errors and history range errors."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Clarified error messages for search syntax errors and history range errors.
"},{"date":"2024-06-10","notes":["Added a marker to the left-side of search results to show which ones you’ve viewed in either TSDR or a summary page.","Fixed a bug where the search refinement didn't reset after navigating away from and back to the search page.","Fixed a bug where coordinates classes weren't being automatically selected."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Added a marker to the left-side of search results to show which ones you’ve viewed in either TSDR or a summary page.
  • Fixed a bug where the search refinement didn't reset after navigating away from and back to the search page.
  • Fixed a bug where coordinates classes weren't being automatically selected.
"},{"date":"2024-06-6","notes":["Removed generic timestamps from search result dates in export files.","Added Help references to the Acceptable Identification of Goods and Services Manual, commonly known as the Trademark ID Manual.","Fixed a bug where sidebar menu options were disabled instead of hidden in Expert mode.","Fixed a bug where class filters weren't shown in Expert mode.","Fixed a bug that caused the Live/Dead filter to display inaccurate totals."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Removed generic timestamps from search result dates in export files.
  • Added Help references to the Acceptable Identification of Goods and Services Manual, commonly known as the Trademark ID Manual.
  • Fixed a bug where sidebar menu options were disabled instead of hidden in Expert mode.
  • Fixed a bug where class filters weren't shown in Expert mode.
  • Fixed a bug that caused the Live/Dead filter to display inaccurate totals.
"},{"date":"2024-05-30","notes":["Removed notification messages instructing users to verify statuses in TSDR."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Removed notification messages instructing users to verify statuses in TSDR.
"},{"date":"2024-05-22","notes":["Fixed a bug that caused the history to display incorrectly for the Refine search by goods or services search bar.","Fixed a bug that prevented mobile users from exporting search results using the Results on page option.","Fixed a bug where the sidebar tooltips appeared in the background for mobile users."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Fixed a bug that caused the history to display incorrectly for the Refine search by goods or services search bar.
  • Fixed a bug that prevented mobile users from exporting search results using the Results on page option.
  • Fixed a bug where the sidebar tooltips appeared in the background for mobile users.
"},{"date":"2024-05-16","notes":["Added the search builder feature to help formulate complex searches when searching by field tag.","Replaced Search by all with General search, which provides more relevant results at the top of the page.","Changed the default search option from Wordmark to General search.","Improved the quality of search results when searching by Owner.","Fixed a bug where certain symbols caused the wordmark to display incorrectly in the results.","Fixed a bug where history references were not recognized during a registration number search.","Fixed a bug where some tooltips were difficult to dismiss.","Fixed a bug where registration numbers were interpreted as history entries in Expert mode.","Improved the clarity of helper text in the search bar when searching by Wordmark.","Added enhancements for better accessibility."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Added the search builder feature to help formulate complex searches when searching by field tag.
  • Replaced Search by all with General search, which provides more relevant results at the top of the page.
  • Changed the default search option from Wordmark to General search.
  • Improved the quality of search results when searching by Owner.
  • Fixed a bug where certain symbols caused the wordmark to display incorrectly in the results.
  • Fixed a bug where history references were not recognized during a registration number search.
  • Fixed a bug where some tooltips were difficult to dismiss.
  • Fixed a bug where registration numbers were interpreted as history entries in Expert mode.
  • Improved the clarity of helper text in the search bar when searching by Wordmark.
  • Added enhancements for better accessibility.
"},{"date":"2024-04-19","notes":["Added or revised the following search fields in the Advanced tab: CU, GS3, LR, OD, OT, and PE."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Added or revised the following search fields in the Advanced tab: CU, GS3, LR, OD, OT, and PE.
"},{"date":"2024-04-15","notes":["Added a tip for bookmark users on the page-not-found error page, including the current system URL.","Added links to go to the system homepage from error pages."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Added a tip for bookmark users on the page-not-found error page, including the current system URL.
  • Added links to go to the system homepage from error pages.
"},{"date":"2024-04-9","notes":["Fixed a bug where the summary page was displaying a different status than the results page.","Removed the hour timestamp from the application or registration dates on the summary page."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Fixed a bug where the summary page was displaying a different status than the results page.
  • Removed the hour timestamp from the application or registration dates on the summary page.
"},{"date":"2024-04-8","notes":["Added a USPTO.gov login, which will allow users to access additional features.","Added a summary page that shows key information about each application or registration. This feature is available to users who are using Expert mode and logged into their USPTO.gov account."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Added a USPTO.gov login, which will allow users to access additional features.
  • Added a summary page that shows key information about each application or registration. This feature is available to users who are using Expert mode and logged into their USPTO.gov account.
"},{"date":"2024-04-3","notes":["Fixed a bug where switching from searching by field tag to searching by goods and services resulted in a warning message.","Fixed a bug where the goods and services search bar was visible on the landing page.","Corrected the URL for the transitioning from TESS handout found on the Get started tab."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Fixed a bug where switching from searching by field tag to searching by goods and services resulted in a warning message.
  • Fixed a bug where the goods and services search bar was visible on the landing page.
  • Corrected the URL for the transitioning from TESS handout found on the Get started tab.
"},{"date":"2024-03-26","notes":["Added a home page announcement about the new summary page for applications and registrations.","Added hard refresh instructions at the bottom of the Get started Help tab for users who encounter an error or defect."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Added a home page announcement about the new summary page for applications and registrations.
  • Added hard refresh instructions at the bottom of the Get started Help tab for users who encounter an error or defect.
"},{"date":"2024-03-19","notes":["Changed the default search refinement to use Wordmark instead of Search by all.","Added a Help section called Language and text formatting explaining how to avoid problems with non-ASCII characters such as smart quotation marks."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Changed the default search refinement to use Wordmark instead of Search by all.
  • Added a Help section called Language and text formatting explaining how to avoid problems with non-ASCII characters such as smart quotation marks.
"},{"date":"2024-03-15","notes":["Fixed a bug where the user couldn't select Search by field tag from the search refinements dropdown before they searched by field tag.","Fixed a bug where the Dead/Abandoned filter showed Dead/Canceled results.","Made modifications to reduce 'Navigation from: undefined' error messages.","Fixed a bug where a goods and services search returned the user's previous search results."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Fixed a bug where the user couldn't select Search by field tag from the search refinements dropdown before they searched by field tag.
  • Fixed a bug where the Dead/Abandoned filter showed Dead/Canceled results.
  • Made modifications to reduce 'Navigation from: undefined' error messages.
  • Fixed a bug where a goods and services search returned the user's previous search results.
"},{"date":"2024-03-7","notes":["Fixed a bug where the sidebar status filters weren't re-enabled after switching from searching with field tags to searching without field tags.","Fixed a bug where multiple files were exported if the user previously exported tagged results, or previously exported 500 results."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Fixed a bug where the sidebar status filters weren't re-enabled after switching from searching with field tags to searching without field tags.
  • Fixed a bug where multiple files were exported if the user previously exported tagged results, or previously exported 500 results.
"},{"date":"2024-02-28","notes":["Updated the field tag help content."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Updated the field tag help content.
"},{"date":"2024-02-20","notes":["Renamed the Basic help content to Get started, and updated the contents. Added a glossary entry for likelihood of confusion."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Renamed the Basic help content to Get started, and updated the contents. Added a glossary entry for likelihood of confusion.
"},{"date":"2024-02-9","notes":["Fixed a bug where only the first 100 tagged results were exported.","Fixed a bug where clicking on a search result's TSDR link launched two TSDR tabs instead of one."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Fixed a bug where only the first 100 tagged results were exported.
  • Fixed a bug where clicking on a search result's TSDR link launched two TSDR tabs instead of one.
"},{"date":"2024-02-2","notes":["Added a date range search example to the common search strings table in the advanced help section.","Removed the landing page notification about the beta test environment ending on January 31, 2024."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Added a date range search example to the common search strings table in the advanced help section.
  • Removed the landing page notification about the beta test environment ending on January 31, 2024.
"},{"date":"2024-01-23","notes":["Added an example to the FD field tag entry in the advanced help section.","Added specific HTTP response status code messaging for error messages."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Added an example to the FD field tag entry in the advanced help section.
  • Added specific HTTP response status code messaging for error messages.
"},{"date":"2024-01-18","notes":["Fixed a bug where combining search lines resulted in a warning instead of a search.","Fixed a bug where field tags with parentheses inside double quotation marks caused extra spaces in the query.","Added double quotation marks for the RG field tag entry for principal-2(f) in the advanced help section."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Fixed a bug where combining search lines resulted in a warning instead of a search.
  • Fixed a bug where field tags with parentheses inside double quotation marks caused extra spaces in the query.
  • Added double quotation marks for the RG field tag entry for principal-2(f) in the advanced help section.
"},{"date":"2024-01-12","notes":["Updated the advanced help and glossary content.","Added a landing page notification about the beta test environment ending on January 31, 2024."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Updated the advanced help and glossary content.
  • Added a landing page notification about the beta test environment ending on January 31, 2024.
"},{"date":"2023-12-15","notes":["Fixed a bug where numbers inside the parentheses of a field tag statement, such as class numbers, were treated as history references."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Fixed a bug where numbers inside the parentheses of a field tag statement, such as class numbers, were treated as history references.
"},{"date":"2023-12-6","notes":["Improved instructions for the RG field tag in the advanced help tab.","Removed the search result information icon and sorting message. The user now chooses how results are sorted.","Changed the announcements text on the landing page to direct users to the feedback button."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Improved instructions for the RG field tag in the advanced help tab.
  • Removed the search result information icon and sorting message. The user now chooses how results are sorted.
  • Changed the announcements text on the landing page to direct users to the feedback button.
"},{"date":"2023-11-30","notes":["This is now the trademark search application; TESS has been retired.","Added the ability to tag results for export in expert mode.","Tagged results may be cleared using the Reset button under Configuration options. Added a new option to reset everything.","Updated the links to the Trademark Design Search Code Manual.","Updated the links to the coordinated classes list."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • This is now the trademark search application; TESS has been retired.
  • Added the ability to tag results for export in expert mode.
  • Tagged results may be cleared using the Reset button under Configuration options. Added a new option to reset everything.
  • Updated the links to the Trademark Design Search Code Manual.
  • Updated the links to the coordinated classes list.
"},{"date":"2023-11-27","notes":["Added the ability to sort search results by wordmark, international class, and serial number."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Added the ability to sort search results by wordmark, international class, and serial number.
"},{"date":"2023-11-20","notes":["Added the ability to export the first 500 results of a search.","The exported Search history file now shows a goods and services-only query in the GoodsAndServicesQuery column. (Be sure to either start the search application in a new tab or press the Reset button and select Clear all search history.).","Improved the messaging for field tag searches to suggest the correct user action."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Added the ability to export the first 500 results of a search.
  • The exported Search history file now shows a goods and services-only query in the GoodsAndServicesQuery column. (Be sure to either start the search application in a new tab or press the Reset button and select Clear all search history.).
  • Improved the messaging for field tag searches to suggest the correct user action.
"},{"date":"2023-11-8","notes":["Improved the workflow for field tag searches."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Improved the workflow for field tag searches.
"},{"date":"2023-11-6","notes":["Reverted to the old link for the Trademark Design Search Code Manual."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Reverted to the old link for the Trademark Design Search Code Manual.
"},{"date":"2023-11-2","notes":["Added an explanation in the basic help tab of how search relevance is determined.","Links to the Trademark Design Search Code Manual are temporarily disabled in preparation for the switch to the new version.","Fixed a bug where some single-word queries with brackets returned an error.","Fixed a bug where the correct owner was not displayed for some searches."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Added an explanation in the basic help tab of how search relevance is determined.
  • Links to the Trademark Design Search Code Manual are temporarily disabled in preparation for the switch to the new version.
  • Fixed a bug where some single-word queries with brackets returned an error.
  • Fixed a bug where the correct owner was not displayed for some searches.
"},{"date":"2023-10-30","notes":["Users can now see all search parameters and filters in an exported Search history file. (Be sure to either start the search application in a new tab or press the Reset button and select Clear all search history.)","The exported GoodsAndServicesTruncated field now shows up to 1,000 characters."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Users can now see all search parameters and filters in an exported Search history file. (Be sure to either start the search application in a new tab or press the Reset button and select Clear all search history.)
  • The exported GoodsAndServicesTruncated field now shows up to 1,000 characters.
"},{"date":"2023-10-25","notes":["Users can open the help and announcements pages in a separate tab or window by right-clicking the hyperlinked text or icons.","Added a temporary direct link to the announcements page:","https://beta-tmsearch.uspto.gov/?page=announcements","We will update this link once TESS retires."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Users can open the help and announcements pages in a separate tab or window by right-clicking the hyperlinked text or icons.
  • Added a temporary direct link to the announcements page:
  • https://beta-tmsearch.uspto.gov/?page=announcements
  • We will update this link once TESS retires.
"},{"date":"2023-10-20","notes":["Added a registration number search refinement. Matching registration numbers are shown in place of serial numbers in the grid, list, and compact list views.","Fixed clear search bug. The clear (X) button was clearing the displayed search text, but didn't remove the actual search content so a search could run with text that wasn't displayed."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Added a registration number search refinement. Matching registration numbers are shown in place of serial numbers in the grid, list, and compact list views.
  • Fixed clear search bug. The clear (X) button was clearing the displayed search text, but didn't remove the actual search content so a search could run with text that wasn't displayed.
"},{"date":"2023-10-18","notes":["Added a live status option. Filter by registered and pending status.","Fixed breadcrumb bug on search results screen. The home screen breadcrumb wasn't being displayed when there were no search results.","Fixed expert mode selection after reset. The expert mode button wasn't changing the mode after clearing all search history.","Added announcement about legacy systems. There are currently a small number of cases where the status shown may differ in trademark search and TSDR.","Updated Help pages. The Basic and Advanced help pages received small updates."],"visible":true,"content":"
  • Added a live status option. Filter by registered and pending status.
  • Fixed breadcrumb bug on search results screen. The home screen breadcrumb wasn't being displayed when there were no search results.
  • Fixed expert mode selection after reset. The expert mode button wasn't changing the mode after clearing all search history.
  • Added announcement about legacy systems. There are currently a small number of cases where the status shown may differ in trademark search and TSDR.
  • Updated Help pages. The Basic and Advanced help pages received small updates.
"},{"date":"2023-10-5","notes":["Added Reset button under Configuration options. Users have the option to either reset all filters or clear their search history.","Updated the Expert mode selection. The redesign provides an easier way to see and change the mode, parallels our design elements like the view selection to provide a smoother visual experience for our users, and meets UX heuristic criteria.","Added an Announcements page. This page will provide a place for release information and announcements that are too lengthy for the home page."],"visible":false,"content":"
  • Added Reset button under Configuration options. Users have the option to either reset all filters or clear their search history.
  • Updated the Expert mode selection. The redesign provides an easier way to see and change the mode, parallels our design elements like the view selection to provide a smoother visual experience for our users, and meets UX heuristic criteria.
  • Added an Announcements page. This page will provide a place for release information and announcements that are too lengthy for the home page.
"},{"date":"2023-09-27","notes":["Added export of search history to an xlsx.","Fix for Status code 0 errors. Added trying the HTTP POST 3 times when there's no connection (status code 0). These are network problems outside of our control.","Fixed bug where design codes were being mistaken for history entries."],"visible":false,"content":"
  • Added export of search history to an xlsx.
  • Fix for Status code 0 errors. Added trying the HTTP POST 3 times when there's no connection (status code 0). These are network problems outside of our control.
  • Fixed bug where design codes were being mistaken for history entries.
"}]}
